subject: Adjust stat_bin binwidth in terms of range?

messages.author: d994cff5897faec8
messages.subject: Adjust stat_bin binwidth in terms of range?
parts:
stat_bin() defaults to a binwidth of "range/30" but there doesn't seem
to be any way to specify a different binwidth in terms of the range,
like maybe I want range/60 or range/15. This would be very useful
when faceting with free x-scale, as then the appropriate absolute
binwidth may be different for each subplot.

Have I missed something?

zw

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Adjust stat_bin binwidth in terms of range?
parts:

No, you haven't missed anything - it's currently not possible, but
it's something I'm working on.
